34 docs/bilingual-copy-and-ux-proposals.md
# Museum tour wording and visitor experience

*Review of 25 November 2026, revision `636d7a4`. The review covered all 46 route cards in English and Hungarian. The route, highlights and selected exhibit interactions were checked in WebKit using iPhone 15 and iPad Pro 11 emulation. Gallery locations still need on-site confirmation.*

## Fix two obstacles on the visitor’s path

1. **Take visitors to the room picker.** Tapping “See the route” placed the first room at the top of the screen. The entire room picker was already above it on both devices. A visitor standing in Legend 6 would have to scroll backwards to discover the shortcut. Label the homepage button **Find your room** / **Teremválasztás** and link it to `#jump`. Point “See the full route” on the highlights page to `./#jump` as well. Check that following either link brings the room choices into view, including on a fresh page load. [Route](../index.html) · [Highlights](../teaser.html) · [Room picker](../lib/app/index.js)

2. **Make every SLK roof phase readable.** The Hungarian label *Csomagtartófedél fel* needed 112 px in a 76 px phone cell. It also overflowed the 81 px cell on the iPad in landscape. The prompt already identifies the boot lid, so the opening sequence can use **Fedél nyílik** and **Fedél zárul**. Use two columns when four labels cannot fit. Check the closing sequence too, so the highlighted wording describes the movement the visitor sees in either direction. [Roof controls](../subsystems/vario-roof.js) · [Hungarian labels](../lib/app/i18n/hu.js) · [Panel layout](../lib/app/theme.css)

## English and Hungarian copy

| Location | What gets in the way | Proposed English | Javasolt magyar szöveg |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 540 K route card | In “when did it join in?” and “mikor lépett működésbe?”, the nearest subject is the letter K. | What does the K stand for? When does the supercharger kick in? | Mit jelent a K betű? Mikor kapcsol be a kompresszor? |
| 300 SL frame comparison | “Lecsökkentve szokásos ajtókhoz” leaves out what was lowered. Visitors can see the sill change height. | Original high sill / Lower sill for conventional doors | Eredeti, magas küszöb / Alacsony küszöb hagyományos ajtóhoz |
| SLK roof prompt | “Watch the steps light up” draws attention to the indicators. In Hungarian, “a lépések kigyulladnak” can suggest catching fire. | Tap “Open the roof”. Which moves first, the boot lid or the roof? | Koppintson a „Tető nyitása” gombra. Mi mozdul meg először, a csomagtartó fedele vagy a tető? |
| Simplex gearbox legend | “Pair in mesh” leaves the parts unnamed. “Kapcsolódó kerékpár” can be read as a bicycle. | Gears in mesh | Kapcsolódó fogaskerekek |
| Offline instructions on the route and highlights | “With signal” and “térerővel” suggest mobile reception even on Wi-Fi. Opening the page starts the download. The ready message tells visitors when they can disconnect. | Open the tour while you’re online. When you see “Ready offline”, every stop is saved on this device. | Nyissa meg a túrát, amíg van internetkapcsolata. Amint az oldal jelzi, hogy a túra offline is elérhető, internet nélkül is megnyithatja bármelyik megállót. |
| Offline confirmation | “Offline is kész” sounds unfinished. Use the same wording in the instructions and the confirmation. | Ready offline. All stops are saved on this device. | A túra offline is elérhető. Az összes megálló mentve van a készüléken. |
| Benz Victoria route card | Both versions say the front wheels follow the same circle. The inner wheel follows a tighter arc, and the model shows the two steering angles. | Why does the inner front wheel turn more sharply? | Kanyarodáskor miért fordul el jobban a belső első kerék? |

The exhibit wording lives with the cars. Gear labels and offline messages are shared across pages. [540 K](../stops/540k/hu.js) · [300 SL](../stops/300sl/hu.js) · [SLK](../stops/slk/hu.js) · [Victoria](../stops/victoria/car.js) · [Gearbox](../subsystems/gearbox.js) · [Offline status](../lib/app/offline.js) · [Hungarian UI text](../lib/app/i18n/hu.js)

## Keep visitors oriented during an experiment

- **Preserve the comparison when switching languages.** On the 300 SL, selecting the lowered frame and switching languages restored the original frame and returned the page to the top. Someone looking up an unfamiliar term loses the example that explains it. Keep the active mechanism and selected setting in view. A practical check is to switch EN → HU → EN at the lowered frame and see the same comparison each time. [Language switch](../lib/app/i18n.js) · [Scroll story](../lib/app/story.js)
- **Give the other two highlights a question and a visual cue.** Three of the 46 route cards already pair a visitor question with something to find at the exhibit. The 300 SL does this well with its upward-opening doors and high sill. On the Blitzen-Benz, try **“If you double the power, do you double the speed?”** / **„Ha megduplázza a teljesítményt, a végsebesség is a kétszeresére nő?”** Have visitors compare the two speeds using the existing power slider. On the 300 SLR, invite them to raise the engine speed and watch where the spring-loaded valve stops following the cam. [Blitzen-Benz](../stops/blitzen-benz/car.js) · [300 SLR](../stops/300slr/car.js)

## Identify the exhibits accurately

**300 SLR Uhlenhaut Coupé.** The highlights introduction calls the exhibit the most expensive car ever sold. The stop itself correctly explains that Mercedes-Benz sold the other coupé. Use **“One of two Uhlenhaut Coupés. Its twin sold for €135 million in 2022.”** / **„A két Uhlenhaut Coupé egyike. A másik példány 2022-ben 135 millió euróért kelt el.”** [Highlights introduction](../teaser.html) · [Exhibit text](../stops/300slr/car.js) · [Mercedes-Benz sale announcement](https://group.mercedes-benz.com/company/news/uhlenhaut-coupe.html)

**O 302 football coach.** The route card, photo description and exhibit text identify the displayed vehicle as the coach that carried the team. Daimler Truck identifies it as a replica. Use **“A replica of West Germany’s 1974 World Cup team bus”** / **„A nyugatnémet válogatott 1974-es világbajnoki csapatbuszának másolata”** wherever visitors first encounter it. Verify the room separately. The tour lists Collection 1, while Daimler Truck’s 2022 exhibit photographs are captioned Collection 4. [English exhibit text](../stops/o302/car.js) · [Hungarian exhibit text](../stops/o302/hu.js) · [Route placement](../stops/tour.js) · [Daimler Truck exhibit description and photographs](https://www.daimlertruck.com/en/newsroom/pressrelease/maximum-bus-comfort-for-the-1974-world-cup-footballers-52102483)

content.text:
# Claude in Chrome browser automation

You have access to browser automation tools (mcp__claude-in-chrome__*) for interacting with web pages in Chrome. Follow these guidelines for effective browser automation.

## Loading deferred tools

If the mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load every tool you expect to need in ONE ToolSearch call — the select query accepts a comma-separated list — never one call per tool. Start with the core set:

ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_close_mcp"

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting.

## GIF recording

When performing multi-step browser interactions that the user may want to review or share, use mcp__claude-in-chrome__gif_creator to record them.

You must ALWAYS:
* Capture extra frames before and after taking actions to ensure smooth playback
* Name the file meaningfully to help the user identify it later (e.g., "login_process.gif")

## Console log debugging

You can use mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_console_messages to read console output. Console output may be verbose. If you are looking for specific log entries, use the 'pattern' parameter with a regex-compatible pattern. This filters results efficiently and avoids overwhelming output. For example, use pattern: "[MyApp]" to filter for application-specific logs rather than reading all console output.

## Alerts and dialogs

IMPORTANT: Do not trigger JavaScript alerts, confirms, prompts, or browser modal dialogs through your actions. These browser dialogs block all further browser events and will prevent the extension from receiving any subsequent commands. Instead, when possible, use console.log for debugging and then use the mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_console_messages tool to read those log messages. If a page has dialog-triggering elements:
1. Avoid clicking buttons or links that may trigger alerts (e.g., "Delete" buttons with confirmation dialogs)
2. If you must interact with such elements, warn the user first that this may interrupt the session
3. Use mcp__claude-in-chrome__javascript_tool to check for and dismiss any existing dialogs before proceeding

If you accidentally trigger a dialog and lose responsiveness, inform the user they need to manually dismiss it in the browser.

## Avoid rabbit holes and loops

When using browser automation tools, stay focused on the specific task. If you encounter any of the following, stop and ask the user for guidance:
- Unexpected complexity or tangential browser exploration
- Browser tool calls failing or returning errors after 2-3 attempts
- No response from the browser extension
- Page elements not responding to clicks or input
- Pages not loading or timing out
- Unable to complete the browser task despite multiple approaches

Explain what you attempted, what went wrong, and ask how the user would like to proceed. Do not keep retrying the same failing browser action or explore unrelated pages without checking in first.

## Tab context and session startup

IMPORTANT: At the start of each browser automation session, call mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp first to get information about the user's current browser tabs. Use this context to understand what the user might want to work with before creating new tabs.

Never reuse tab IDs from a previous/other session. Follow these guidelines:
1. Only reuse an existing tab if the user explicitly asks to work with it
2. Otherwise, create a new tab with mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp
3. If a tool returns an error indicating the tab doesn't exist or is invalid, call tabs_context_mcp to get fresh tab IDs
4. When a tab is closed by the user or a navigation error occurs, call tabs_context_mcp to see what tabs are available

  photo: { alt: "Klaus Ludwig 3-as rajtszámú, 1992-es Mercedes-Benz 190 E 2.5-16 Evolution II DTM-autója a Mercedes-Benz Múzeumban, balról nézve" },
  components: [
    {
      label: "Aerodinamika",
      params: {
        label: "Teljes gázzal az autópályán",
        shapes: [{ label: "Evolution II karosszériacsomag" }, { label: "2.3-16 karosszéria" }],
      },
      talk: [
        "A túraautó-versenyek szabályai minden versenyautóhoz utcai változatot követeltek: 1990-ben 502 Evolution II készült, hogy a DTM-autó a karosszériacsomaggal versenyezhessen.",
        "Az első spoilert, a széles kerékíveket, a küszöbborításokat és az állítható hátsó szárnyat a szélcsatornában egyetlen rendszerként formálták. Az eredmény: kb. 0,29-es légellenállási tényező a 2.3-16 0,32-jével szemben, és nagy sebességnél jóval kisebb felhajtóerő.",
        "A levegő legyőzéséhez szükséges teljesítmény a sebesség köbével nő. 235 LE-vel az utcai autó kb. 250 km/h-t ér el.",
        "Ez Klaus Ludwig 1992-es DTM-autója; a versenyváltozatnak jóval több mint 350 LE-je volt. Hátsó szárnya a légellenállás árán leszorítóerőt ad.",
        "A szélcsatorna az autó középvonalán vett metszetet mutatja. Nyomás nézetben a levegő az orrnak és a szélvédőnek feszül, a tető fölött felgyorsul, a csomagtartó mögött pedig leválik, és örvénylő nyomvizet hagy, amely visszahúzza az autót. A hátsó szárny kimaradt a metszetből.",
      ],
    },
    {
      label: "Versenymotor",
      prompt: "Percenként 9000-es fordulatszámnál hány ezredmásodpercig tart a szívóütem? Váltson a két fordulatszám között, és figyelje a két kék szívószelepet.",
      answer: "3,3 ezredmásodpercig: fél főtengely-fordulatig. 4500/min-nél 6,7 ms jut rá. Kétszeres fordulaton feleannyi idő marad a töltésre, ezért lélegzik minden henger két szívószelepen át.",
      params: { label: "2,5 literes négyhengeres, 16 szelep · gyújtási sorrend 1-3-4-2" },
      talk: [
        "A versenymotor: négy henger 97,8 mm-es furattal és 82,8 mm-es lökettel, 2,5 liter, két felül fekvő vezérműtengellyel és hengerenként négy szeleppel.",
        "A korai DTM-változat 8500/min-nél 245 kW-ot adott, és 9500/min-ig foroghatott. Az 1992-es bajnoki autóra a Mercedes-Benz legfeljebb 274 kW-ot (373 LE) ad meg.",
        "Az utcai Evolution II furata 97,3 mm, teljesítménye 173 kW (235 LE) volt.",
        "A rövid löket kordában tartja a dugattyúk sebességét: 9000/min-nél is átlagosan kb. 25 m/s-mal járnak fel-le a hengerben.",
        "A kijelzett idők 180°-os főtengely-elfordulásra, egy szívóütemre vonatkoznak. A szívószelepek valamivel előtte nyílnak és utána zárnak, ahogy a vezérlés beállítja.",
      ],
    },
  ],
  note: "Az aerodinamikai értékek itt az utcai autókéi; a múzeum versenyautóját leszorítóerőre állították be.",
  unverified: [
    "Homlokfelületek, tömegek, gördülési ellenállás és a hajtáslánc hatásfoka",
    "A versenyautó teljesítménye és beállítása",
    "A jármű körvonala és középsíkú metszete: a megállóhely fotójáról (oldalnézet) átrajzolva az illesztett kamerán át, kb. ±10 cm; a metszetből a hátsó szárny kimaradt, az alja sík",
    "Szélcsatorna: kétdimenziós metszet a valódinál jóval kisebb Reynolds-számmal (kb. 10⁴ a 10⁷ helyett), a kerekek kívül esnek rajta; az ellenállás megoszlása a metszetre vonatkozik",
    "Versenymotor: hajtórúdhossz, hengertávolság, a blokk dőlése és helyzete az autóban; karburátoros szívóoldallal ábrázolva",

};

**Done since the last update**
- **CFD runs:** the tunnel runs offline on 10 cores, with the wheels held still (spinning tyres on the block-shaped cells pumped air through the model). Each case is computed on a 40 mm and a 28 mm grid.
- **Forces:** I now take drag, lift and the load on each axle from the pressure on the car's surface. The solver's own force sum matched that in the changes between cases but put the flap's effect on the wrong axle, so it now only serves as the noise estimate. Friction is left out, which is fine for showing the idea.
- **40 mm results:**
  - The raised flap adds rear downforce (+0.12 in coefficient, about 50 kg at 200 km/h) and costs drag (+0.08), with the front slightly lighter. That is what a wing should do.
  - The lip moved forward adds drag; its effect on lift isn't clearly above the noise yet.
  - The arch trim removes only 33 mm, less than one cell on the 40 mm grid, so only the 28 mm grid can show it. If it stays inside the noise there, the page shows the flow change and "–" instead of a number, as the proposal asks.
- **New step `subsystems/race-aero.js`:** one button per case. It draws the centre-plane slice and a slice just behind the front wheel (pressure or speed), streamlines with moving dots, a marker on the changed part, and arrows for extra drag and for the load on each axle. Readouts are in kg and kW at 200 km/h, plus one sentence that is also read out to screen readers. It renders with no page errors.
- **Evo II stop:**
  - The race-aero step comes first, with the question "Why would a racing driver accept more drag?" in English and Hungarian.
  - The autobahn comparison is now the last step, "Road car on the autobahn".

  - The mesh is git-ignored so it never reaches the public repo.
- **Engines:** checked on screen. The 190 SL rockers, the Simplex side exhaust and the Daimler engine draw correctly. I tilted the Evo II engine view so each cylinder's two inlet valves show.
- **260 D:**
